changelog:
Initial release of xiaohongshu-note-audit

- Audits social content-marketing notes for policy compliance and shadowban/throttling risk.
- Scans for banned words, superlative/absolute-claim (极限词) violations, and sensitive content.
- Flags risks and returns actionable, compliant rewrite suggestions.
- Designed for pre-post review of social notes to avoid takedown or account penalties.
- Requires API key from wsdsocial.com for access.
summary: Audit social content-marketing note content for policy compliance and shadowban / traffic-throttling risk. Scans for banned words, superlative / absolute-claim (极限词) violations, and sensitive content, flags the risks, and returns actionable, compliant rewrite suggestions to avoid throttling, takedown, or account penalties. Use when the user wants to check a social note before posting, do 违禁词检测 / 合规审核 / 笔记预审, review social copy for compliance, or assess shadowban / 限流 risk. Trigger keywords: social note, content marketing, compliance, audit, 审核, 违禁词, 极限词, 限流, shadowban, moderation. Requires an API key from wsdsocial.com.
